concept_reviews.comment: Revise mastery from mastered to fragile with medium confidence. General prior knowledge of vectors and matrices does not establish positive-semidefinite/positive-definite terminology. No bridge needs to be added because the only directly supported second-order item is excluded; this correction is for assessment validity and must not expand the selected pathway.

pathway_change_reviews.comment: This record describes disciplinary framing and representation depth, not regrouping. Change its type to change_theory_implementation_application_depth, use affected contract IDs RC-001, RC-002, and RC-010 rather than unit IDs, and state that idealized energy/calibration framing and an iteration table alter explanatory emphasis without changing mathematical claims.

This record also describes a depth/framing adaptation rather than regrouping. Change its type to change_theory_implementation_application_depth and use affected contract IDs RC-004, RC-005, RC-006, RC-007, RC-009, RC-011, RC-014, and RC-015. Its revised rationale should distinguish engineering interpretation through convergence histories from any claim that engineering objectives are automatically convex or that GD is universally suitable.

Retain this as the single regroup_contract_items record, but replace unit IDs with all 12 selected RC item IDs and make the baseline/adaptation comparison structural: the P0 mixed groups are split into auditable single-item objective, stationarity, update, smoothness, descent, step-selection, convexity, conditioning, and guarantee units. Do not use unit-purpose renaming alone as evidence of regrouping. Add a separate reorder_learning_units record for moving RC-013 directly after RC-011.

structure_review.comment: Move GD-ME-U12 (Armijo backtracking) to immediately after GD-ME-U06 (constant-step choices), giving the sequence GD-ME-U01, U02, U03, U04, U05, U06, U12, U07, U08, U09, U10, U11. For an engineering/numerical-methods learner, the practical alternative should be compared directly with the constant-step rule before the lesson turns to convex and strongly-convex convergence regimes. The declared prerequisites remain satisfied. Add a reorder_learning_units change record for this move.

overall_comment: The selected GD content, bridge needs for smoothness/convexity/conditioning, early engineering iteration trace, context boundaries, convergence coverage, and learning-goal mappings are pedagogically sound. Revision is required to avoid overstating matrix-definiteness mastery, to place Armijo beside the constant-step rule, and to correct the pathway-change taxonomy and affected IDs. These are bounded revisions; all other item, concept, goal, dependency, unit-purpose, and scope decisions are approved.
